## Low level SGP functions

These functions are responsible for all student growth percentile and student growth projection calculation.

::: {.reference-index}

[`studentGrowthPercentiles()`](studentGrowthPercentiles.html)
:   Student Growth Percentiles

[`studentGrowthProjections()`](studentGrowthProjections.html)
:   Student Growth Projections

:::

## High level SGP functions

These functions simplify operational SGP calculations as wrappers for low level functions.

::: {.reference-index}

[`abcSGP()`](abcSGP.html)
:   Perform 6 step sequence: prepareSGP, analyzeSGP, combineSGP, summarizeSGP, visualizeSGP, and outputSGP

[`analyzeSGP()`](analyzeSGP.html)
:   Analyze student data to produce student growth percentiles and student growth projections

[`baselineSGP()`](baselineSGP.html)
:   Analyze student data to produce student growth percentiles and coefficient matrices from a baseline (i.e. multiple cohort) norm group

[`combineSGP()`](combineSGP.html)
:   Combine student data and SGP results

[`outputSGP()`](outputSGP.html)
:   Output student data and SGP results for a variety of purposes

[`prepareSGP()`](prepareSGP.html)
:   Prepare data for SGP analyses

[`rliSGP()`](rliSGP.html)
:   Wrapper function associated with SGP analyses for Renaissance Learning Incorporated (RLI) interim STAR assessments.

[`summarizeSGP()`](summarizeSGP.html)
:   Summarize student scale scores, proficiency levels and student growth percentiles according to user specified summary group variables

[`testSGP()`](testSGP.html)
:   Test SGP Package functions

[`updateSGP()`](updateSGP.html)
:   Function to update SGP object with additional year's analyses

[`visualizeSGP()`](visualizeSGP.html)
:   Visualize data from SGP analyses

:::

## SGP utility functions

These functions are used in various ways as part of SGP analyses.

::: {.reference-index}

[`bubblePlot()`](bubblePlot.html)
:   Core bubblePlot function for SGP

[`bubblePlot_Styles()`](bubblePlot_Styles.html)
:   bubblePlot_Styles providing various uses of the core bubblePlot function

[`courseProgressionSGP()`](courseProgressionSGP.html)
:   Identify potential course progressions for SGP analyses

[`createKnotsBoundaries()`](createKnotsBoundaries.html)
:   Function to create Knots and Boundaries from supplied data in LONG format.

[`capwords()`](capwords.html)
:   Function for converting all caps to mixed case. Useful in data cleaning.

[`getStateAbbreviation()`](getStateAbbreviation.html)
:   Function for converting state/organization abbreviations to long form and back.

[`gofSGP()`](gofSGP.html)
:   Function for producing goodness of fit plots using existing SGP object

[`growthAchievementPlot()`](growthAchievementPlot.html)
:   growthAchievementPlot for SGP

[`splineMatrix-class`](splineMatrix-class.html)
:   Class "splineMatrix"

[`SGP-class`](SGP-class.html)
:   Class "SGP"

[`studentGrowthPlot()`](studentGrowthPlot.html)
:   Create a student growth and achievement chart

[`studentGrowthPlot_Styles()`](studentGrowthPlot_Styles.html)
:   studentGrowthPlot_Styles providing base templates for the core studentGrowthPlot function

:::

## SGP meta-data for state/organization level analyses

This internal data set contains meta-data and configurations used as part of state/organization level analyses.

::: {.reference-index}

[`SGPstateData`](SGPstateData.html)
:   State assessment program data from large scale state assessments for use with SGP package

:::
